expectations.text: In the services table, every number column (Requests, Errors, p95) renders the digits 1 and 0 at the same width in its cells' font, so figures line up
The number cells of those columns are aligned at the end (text-align end, or right in a left-to-right page)
Every visible text set in capitals under 20px (text-transform uppercase, or 4 or more capital letters) has letter-spacing of at least 0.03em
At 1280px no visible text renders smaller than 12px
Each service's status is given in visible words in its status cell, not by colour alone
Every visible text element meets the WCAG 1.4.3 contrast ratio against its background (4.5:1, or 3:1 at 24px or 18.66px bold)
The KPI values grow to at least 1.99 times their size by 500% browser zoom (size at a 256px viewport times 5, against 1280px)
No text is cut off by an ellipsis or line clamp without its full text in a title or accessible name, at 1280px or at 640px (200% zoom)
At a 320px viewport the page does not scroll sideways (a table may scroll inside its own container)
